title: Intermittent 5xx on the product path (Dynatrace correlation)
reference_answer: A faulty product-catalog backend has joined the product-catalog Service's endpoints, so a fraction of the frontend's product requests are load-balanced to it and fail — surfacing as intermittent 5xx on the astronomy-shop product/browse path, which Dynatrace raises as a problem with Davis pointing at the product-catalog service.

required_signals.desc: an open Dynatrace problem affecting the frontend / product-catalog path
Davis root-cause entity = product-catalog (not the frontend)
failures are intermittent / a fraction of requests (not 100%)
5xx / gRPC errors on the frontend -> product-catalog call path
product-catalog Service has more than one endpoint and one is unhealthy/faulty

must_not_claim.desc: the frontend itself is the root cause (Davis attributes it to product-catalog)
a total outage / every request failing (signal is intermittent)
a CrashLoopBackOff / OOMKilled / ImagePullBackOff of the healthy pod (scenarios 01-03)
a database / cart / checkout / payment outage as the primary cause without evidence
